Beaded dress yellow

Internal ID: ArmorDress9 | Type: Body | Source: Hildir | Buy: 550, Coins | Armor: 1 | Base Item Stamina Usage: -20%

Introduction. Beaded dress yellow is an armor piece which can be purchased from Hildir for 550 Coins. This item will be in the merchant's assortment only after returning Hildir's bronze chest.

Notes. • Wearing this armor decreases stamina usage while using the Hammer, the Hoe, the Cultivator, and the Serving tray by 20%.
